For a 50-person Indian company, these are three currently available options worth comparing:

Service	Price	Reliability / strengths	Key limitations
ITILITE	₹99/user/month Growth → ~₹4,950/month for 50 users	India-focused workflows, approvals, expense + travel, GST reconciliation at Enterprise	Dedicated support/account manager starts at higher tier; Enterprise pricing is custom 
Itilite

Offistrip	₹7,999/month Growth	Central booking, policies, approvals, dashboards and GST invoicing; no long-term lock-in	Smaller provider; confirm 24×7 human support and international coverage before signing 
Offistrip

FCM Travel	Custom quote	Large global TMC, 24×7 support, negotiated hotel/air rates, dedicated consultants and duty-of-care tooling	Pricing isn't public; likely more procurement/implementation effort than a lightweight platform 
FCM Travel
+1

Purchase terms to verify: per-booking/service fees, GST treatment, cancellation/change handling fees, after-hours support SLA, hotel/airline inventory, credit terms, implementation fees, and minimum contract period.

For a 50-person company, ITILITE and Offistrip are the transparent-price options; FCM requires an RFP/quote.
